title: Sabine Quillon
kicker: a brisk field agent who can brief the job if Marlowe should not carry it

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A polished elf factor in white-and-gold field dress holds a sealed scroll tube with immaculate gloves, every pin and clasp arranged to look effortless.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Immaculate competence built as armor. She keeps the contract, not the consequences. Honest in brief flashes, mostly about how little she is paid to be honest.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: Cargo handoff Contract terms A clean start signal
